BiblicalUsage: Iezer was a son of Gilead, and the father of the family of the Iezrites. In Numbers 26:30 the sons of Gilead are numbered, of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites, in the census of Israel in the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Iezer's name lives in the census: one man, one family, counted among the tribes on the way to the land.
